title: .env.example drift (D-ENV-EXAMPLE): keys the code reads are missing (ETH_FORK_RPC_URL, NODE_ENV), and keys it ships are read nowhere (TEST_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY, three explorer keys, RPC_TIMEOUT_MS, the two coinbase-bribe flags)

evidence.ref: comm of the .env.example keys (git show <base>:.env.example, 145 keys) against literal process.env reads in src, scripts, hardhat.config.ts, vitest.config.ts and dashboard/src at the base, followed by a per-key git grep -lw of each candidate over src scripts test hardhat.config.ts vitest.config.ts dashboard
evidence.note: read but undocumented: ETH_FORK_RPC_URL (hardhat.config.ts:98, scripts/capture-launch.ts:195, test/fork/setup.ts:8), NODE_ENV (src/api/middleware/auth.ts:64, the cookie Secure flag); documented but read nowhere: TEST_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY (.env.example:290), BSCSCAN_API_KEY/BASESCAN_API_KEY/ARBISCAN_API_KEY (:115-117, marked deprecated), RPC_TIMEOUT_MS (:237; only a registry descriptor at src/config.ts:180), MEV_BUY_COINBASE_BRIBE_ENABLED and MEV_SELL_COINBASE_BRIBE_ENABLED (:281, :249, marked reserved); per-chain keys are read through prefix templates and were not counted as unused
the research hint named MEV_STRATEGY as read but missing; re-measured: only a comment saying MEV_STRATEGY is not consulted, so it is not a missing key

sibling_sites_checked: The registered env-contract findings: AUD-DB-016 (validateEnvVars list vs code, 18 unregistered keys), AUD-DB-011 (ALCHEMY_URL vs ETH_RPC_URL, NETWORK default), AUD-TX-008 (RPC_TIMEOUT_MS read nowhere), AUD-TESTI-019 (STOP_LOSS_PERCENT used by one fork test; src reads STOP_LOSS_PCT, which .env.example:70 documents). This entry adds only what those do not cover.
severity_rationale: S4 hygiene: documentation drift; the behaviour-relevant cases are already registered at their own severity (AUD-TX-008, AUD-API-007, AUD-DB-016).
recommendation: Phase 25 (cleanup): add ETH_FORK_RPC_URL (shell-only note, plan 22-05/22-11 already adds it) and NODE_ENV, delete or wire the unused keys, and add a sync test of .env.example against the keys the code reads (the 22-05 test/.env.test sync test is the model).
